testimony.subject: Status of fee patent and allotted land, Allotment No. 226
testimony.key_claims: Patent received at Agency Office in 1917, receipted with protest, filed for record in Pawnee County. Land sold to C. E. Vandervoort for $2000, which was a good price at the time. Allottee did not owe purchaser any money. No mortgage. No fraud evidence. Age 48, good health, no property or money accumulated. No income from any source except shares in Pawnee annuity. Wife and two children dependent on him.
